title: The Train Returned His Missing Sister

shots.visual_event: On the rain-soaked abandoned platform, Arin and quadruped Tick face an impossible train emerging through fog.
shots.dialogue_audio: Narrator: “For three hundred and seventeen nights, Arin waited for the train that stole his sister.”

shots.visual_event: The carriage door opens. Meera appears behind wet glass, frightened rather than relieved.
A blank brass exchange plaque wakes red between Arin’s hand and Meera.
shots.dialogue_audio: Station: “One may return. One must take their place.”

shots.visual_event: Arin steps over the threshold while golden clockwork light moves Meera outward; Tick reaches with one front paw.
The train departs. Meera and Tick run beside Arin’s rain-streaked window.
Inside, the clock-masked Conductor offers Arin a blank brass ticket as twelve doors wake behind him.
shots.dialogue_audio: Conductor: “Welcome aboard, Passenger One. Twelve doors remain.”

end_card.text: THE NEXT DOOR OPENS AT MIDNIGHT
